name: Mathematician
ability: Each night, you learn how many players’ abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
wakes: Every night, including the first, near the end of the night.
learns: A number: how many players' abilities worked abnormally since dawn (first night: since setup) because of another character's ability.
malfunction: Drunk or poisoned: may learn any number (misinformation offered centrally, storyteller picks).

jinxes.text: The Chambermaid can detect if the Mathematician will wake tonight.
The Mathematician learns if the Drunk's ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.
The Mathematician learns if the Lunatic attacks a different player than the real Demon attacked.
The Mathematician learns if the Marionette's ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.

rulings.text: Only malfunctions caused by another character's ability count: information that should have been true but was false, or an ability that should have worked but did not.
The Mathematician learns only the count, not which players were affected.
The Mathematician does not detect their own ability failing.

Drunkenness or poisoning itself is not counted, only a resulting failure: a poisoned Empath given true info is not counted; a poisoned Soldier dying to the Imp is; a Recluse registering evil to the Chef is.
With a Vortox in play the number learned must be false (example: 6 abnormal, learns 4).

tests.name: nothing abnormal
tests.setup: Alice Mathematician, Bob Empath, Carol Imp, Dave Scarlet Woman, Eve Chef.
tests.actions: First night: Empath and Chef receive true info.

tests.name: poisoned info counts
tests.setup: Alice Mathematician, Bob Empath, Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
tests.actions: Night 2: Poisoner poisons Bob; storyteller gives Bob a false number.

tests.name: poisoned player given true info not counted
tests.setup: Alice Mathematician, Bob Empath, Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
tests.actions: Night 2: Poisoner poisons Bob; storyteller gives Bob the true number.

tests.name: drunk jinx: drunk's false info counts
tests.setup: Alice Mathematician, Bob Drunk (believes Empath), Carol Imp, Dave Scarlet Woman, Eve Chef.
tests.actions: Night 2: storyteller gives Bob a false Empath number.

tests.name: poisoned mathematician
tests.setup: Alice Mathematician, Bob Empath, Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Chef.
tests.actions: Night 2: Poisoner poisons Alice; Bob gets true info.
tests.expected: Misinformation options (any number other than 0) are offered centrally; storyteller picks 2 and Alice learns 2.

tests.name: lunatic jinx
tests.setup: Alice Mathematician, Bob Lunatic (believes Imp), Carol Imp, Dave Poisoner, Eve Soldier.
tests.actions: Night 2: Lunatic chooses Eve; Imp chooses and kills Bob.
tests.expected: Alice learns 1 (the Lunatic attacked a different player than the real Demon).
